name: Night Drive
tagline: A dark instrument cluster: one dim cyan road ahead, one magenta lamp on the thing that moves.
mood: Driving at night with the dash dimmed: everything is quiet and legible, one strip glows softly, and the only thing that moves is the lamp at the end of it.
rationale: A tool glanced at a hundred times a day needs most of its surface to be quiet; Night Drive puts everything in fg and dim and spends color on exactly two hues for two ideas, the road (the meter, a dim cyan that brightens only near its end) and the lamp (the doing step and the meter's tail-light, magenta), so a glance lands on the health glyph and then on what moves. The lamp is a colour, not a glyph: the meter has no weight scale, only three marks, the lit road `█`, the tail-light `▐` (a right-half sliver, narrower and brighter than the road, always the last lit cell) and the road ahead `·` (dim cat's-eye studs on a bg2 lane), so the live cell is told apart by hue and by being narrower than the road rather than by a shade step, and the 43 unlit cells of the header meter read as quiet studs rather than a shaded slab. The spacing complaint is answered with a stated grid: every section is a bold label on a dashed lane line, one blank row between sections, one glyph column and one 5-cell meta column shared by NEEDS YOU and SIGNALS so texts start on the same cell (col 10), steps indented four cells under their phase, the meter exactly cols 2–71, and every sha, agent and count right-justified to the same end column (col 71). The band uses one separator (a dim dashed `┆`, the lane line turned vertical) with one space each side, so segments stop blending into each other.
tokenMap: bg: never painted by the mod (the terminal's own background shows through; the mock page uses #0b0f1a / #f5f7fb). fg: ThemeKey `text`. dim: `dimColor` (the mock's #5f6d87 / #6a7690), which also draws the `·` studs of the meter's unlit lane (3:1 on the dark bg2 lane, 3.7:1 on the light one, enough for a non-text mark). accent: hex #22e3ff on dark, #006983 on light (5.6:1 on the light bg, 4.9:1 on the light bg2), chosen by the `theme` config row (a light theme name selects the light pair), used on three things only: the lit `█` road cells of the meter (band and pane), the two `▶` glyphs (health working, current phase, and the `▶B` chip) and the active footer chip's label. Everything else that carries a name is `text`: the band's step title (bold), the section labels PLAN and SIGNALS (bold, the `┄` rule dim), the sparkline (dim). accent2: hex #ff3fd6 / #b0169a, used in two places only: the doing `●` (at most three on screen by the worklog rule) and the meter's tail-light `▐`, the last lit cell, in the pane's Raster and in the band's Text meter; it never colours a shade or a block run, so the lamp is carried by hue and width alone, and on the light pair (where #b0169a and #006983 sit at the same luminance) it is still told apart by the half-cell of background inside the `▐`. bg2: hex #182238 / #e3eaf7 as `Box backgroundColor` on the current step row and the active footer chip, and as the cell background of the pane meter's unlit lane and of the tail-light cell in the Raster, so the sliver's dark half reads as road surface. success/warning/error: ThemeKeys `success`, `warning`, `error`, never hex, so verdict glyphs keep their meaning across every theme: `✓` done/passed → success; `✗` failed and `!` needs you/blocked → error; `?` decision and `~` drift → warning. Rule: verdicts take theme keys, motion takes the accents, so cyan `▶` and magenta `●` are a theme choice, not a swap of success. One admitted exception: inside the Raster, cells are 0x00RRGGBB only and cannot take theme keys, so the gate-pass moment on the tail-light uses the success hex of the pair the theme row selected (#3ddc97 on dark, #1e8a55 on light, 4.6:1 on the light lane). The pair is read once at session start (`$.config.list()` is async; the draw is sync) and cached in state, refreshed by an `on('config.set', { key: 'theme' })` hook; if the row is missing or names an unknown theme, the Text surfaces fall back to ThemeKeys (`suggestion` for accent, `claude` for accent2, `subtle` for bg2) and the pane mounts the Text meter (`█` road on `suggestion`, the `▐` lamp on `claude`, the `·` lane dim) in place of the Raster, so nothing is ever unreadable. On the glow row the right column (`opus 6m Edit`) is drawn in `text`, not dim, since bg2 lifts the band by about 5% luminance and dim text would fall under 4.5:1 there.

otherTabs: Plan keeps the same header, meter and footer, then every phase as a `▶`/`✓`/`○` header row on the lane-line grid (`▾`/`▸` fold arrow after the glyph, count at col 71) with its steps indented four cells and the one doing row carrying the bg2 glow wherever it is. Log is the same label-column rhythm: a dim 5-cell `hh:mm` column, the 2-cell gap, then the line from col 10, Rulings in warning, `dod ✓` runs in success, newest first under a `LOG ┄┄┄` rule. Step details open with the step's own glyph and title, a dim `B UI · step 8 of 18` line, then a `DETAILS ┄┄┄` section whose labels (status, note, commit, gate, agents, drift, asks) share one 8-cell column; the doing step's status row glows bg2 like its plan row. Needs you lists each question under a plain `NEEDS YOU ┄┄┄` rule (no count tail; the rows are the count) in the same `? D1   text` shape, with `blocks B4` dim beneath (prefixed `asked hh:mm ·` only when the log holds an `asked D1` line), the why, and the option buttons as footer-style chips where the recommended one is the accent-on-bg2 chip (`[ per seat (recommended) ]` as the engine's primary variant) and the rest plain; drift follows under `NOTICED ┄┄┄`, answered items under `ANSWERED ┄┄┄` in success. Finished run: health `✓`, elapsed reads `took 3h40m`, the meter is the whole road lit in the dim gradient with no tail-light and no bright cells (the brightest state is never the resting one) and nothing breathes; an empty plan, like any run at done = 0, is the plain dim `·` lane with no lamp, since nothing has moved yet.
glyphs: todo `○` dim · doing `●` accent2 (magenta) bold · done `✓` success · blocked `!` error · skipped `–` dim · current phase `▶` accent (cyan) bold, done phase `✓` success, todo phase `○` dim (also the chip strip `✓A ▶B ○C`) · decision `?` warning bold · blocker `!` error bold · drift `~` warning · health: `▶` working in accent, `!` needs you in error, `✗` gate red in error, `✓` finished in success · section rule `┄` dim, band and header separator `┆` dim · fold arrows `▾`/`▸` in the Plan tab · meter: three marks and no weight scale, the lamp told by colour and width, never by a shade: the lit road `█` (accent), the tail-light `▐` (accent2; the right-half block, a narrower magenta sliver that is always the last lit cell and counts as one full cell) and the road ahead `·` (dim, cat's-eye studs). The band and every terminal Text meter draw 10 cells, round(7/18·10) = 4 lit, so `███▐······`; the pane's terminal meter is a 70×1 Raster: 26 `█` in a dim cyan gradient (#0e7f91 at the left to #15a9c0, the two road cells just behind the lamp at full #22e3ff), the 27th cell `▐` in accent2 on the bg2 lane colour (round(7/18·70) = 27 lit), then 43 `·` in dim on the bg2 lane; no lamp when done = 0 (the plain `·` lane) or done = total (the whole road lit). On proportional surfaces, where `·` is narrower than a block, the Text meter draws its lane as `█` in dim instead, so all ten cells keep one width. No shade block (U+2591–2593) anywhere in the theme. · sparkline: block elements `▁▂▃▄▅` for 1–5 commits per cell and a space for 0, one cell per hour over the last 8 hours (the mock series 0 0 0 1 0 1 2 2 sums to the sample's 6 commits today, the latest in the current hour), drawn dim on the git signal row. Every glyph is width-1 BMP: box drawing, block elements (`█ ▐ ▁▂▃▄▅`), geometric shapes and the Latin-1 middot `·`; no braille, no emoji.
spacingRules: Pane: `paddingX={1}`, so content runs cols 2–71 of 72; nothing is drawn past col 71 and every right-column run (elapsed, count, sha, agent, `? D1`, `52s`, `6 today`, `$4.10`, chips) ends exactly at col 71 via a flexGrow spacer. Header is three rows (title row, branch ┆ gate-command row, the meter) with no blank inside it. The meter row is exactly 70 cells, cols 2–71: the lit road starts at col 2, the `·` lane ends at col 71 on the same right edge as every right column, and the lamp is always exactly one cell with no gap or pad between road, lamp and lane (the half-cell of dark inside `▐` is the glyph's own, not spacing). Sections: one blank row before every section label; the label row is ` LABEL ┄┄┄ tail`, label at col 2 in bold, the rule dim and filling to the tail, the tail ending at col 71; NEEDS YOU has no tail (its rows are the count; `+n more` appears only when `max` truncates the list), PLAN's tail is the phase chip strip, SIGNALS has none; never two labels adjacent, never a label directly under the meter. One text column: NEEDS YOU and SIGNALS share a glyph-or-label column at col 3, a 5-cell meta column at cols 3–7 or 5–9 (`gate `, `git  `, `ctx  ` / `D1`, the age `3m`, left-aligned) and a 2-cell gap, so every text and value in both sections starts at col 10. PLAN rows: phase glyph at col 3 and title from col 5; step glyphs at col 5 and titles from col 7 (four-cell indent under the phase), the bg2 glow row spans cols 2–71 as a full-width band so its edges line up with the rules above and below (in two-column mode it spans the left column only). Footer: one blank row above it, chips separated by two spaces, the active tab a one-space-padded bg2 chip, hotkeys dim and one space before their label. Band: 1-cell outer padding; `glyph␣count␣meter␣␣step` as the code lays it out, the meter always 10 cells (road, one lamp, lane), then every telemetry segment is `␣┆␣segment` (one dashed separator with one space each side, the separator its own dim Seg so a toned segment never colors it), the right pins are two-space separated and sit at the band's last cell with at least three cells of road between.
desktopNotes: Desktop, VS Code and mobile draw in a proportional font, so the lane line goes: a section is its label alone (bold text, warning for NEEDS YOU) with `marginTop={1}` and the tail (the PLAN chips) after three spaces, as the current code already does. Right columns keep their alignment through `Box flexGrow={1}` spacers, never through space padding, and the shared 5-cell meta/label column becomes a fixed-width Box (`width={7}`, label plus gap) so texts and values still start together. Raster is a fragment there, so the pane meter is an `Svg`: a 100%×6px rounded rect with the dim cyan linear gradient for the lit share, two brighter cells' worth at #22e3ff, the tail-light as a magenta cap half a cell wide (the `▐` drawn as geometry, so it stays narrower than the road), and the unlit lane in bg2 with a dim 1px dot centred in every cell's slot (the `·` studs). The band meter (desktop only; VS Code has no band) is Text, but `·` is narrower than a block in a proportional font, so there the lane is drawn as `█` in dim: `███▐██████` with the road in accent, the sliver in accent2 and the lane in dim, one block width for all ten cells, so the meter keeps its length as it fills and the lamp is still a colour and a narrower sliver. The sparkline is the same `▁▂▃▄▅` block text on mobile and VS Code (one glyph set everywhere, no font risk) and an `Svg` polyline (8 points, dim stroke) on desktop. The glow row is the strongest cross-surface element: `Box backgroundColor` with the bg2 hex survives every surface, and so do the magenta `●` and cyan `▶`. No animation anywhere off the terminal: the Svg meter is static (`isInteractive` is not used), and the mobile pane is the same drawing without the meter gradient. The footer chips are Buttons with Text chips on every surface; on mobile the active chip is the same bg2 band so the active tab is visible without a monospace bracket.

animation.idea: Only the meter's tail-light moves: the `▐` sliver at the end of the lit road. At rest it breathes, a slow ramp through three luminances of the same magenta; when a step is marked done the lamp drives forward over the newly earned cells one by one, each `·` stud it passes turning to lit road `█` behind it, like the road being revealed, then the lamp settles at the new end. The glyph never changes, only its colour and its cell.
animation.trigger: A step going to done (the Raster sweep, computed from the old and new `counts(doc)`); a gate passing paints the tail-light in the success hex of the selected pair for three seconds instead of the breath, then the breath resumes (a state tick, no frames); nothing happens for a question raised, which is already the `!` health and the warning section, and nothing ever flashes.
animation.cadence: Rest: 1 frame per second, the tail-light cell cycling through three stops of one hue (#ff3fd6 → #e036c2 → #c22ea9 and back up; the lowest stop stays above 4.5:1 on the dark bg), so adjacent frames differ by one small step and nothing ever toggles. Sweep: 4 frames at 250 ms, one blit per earned cell (the lamp moves one cell on, the cell it left becomes a gradient `█`), at most one second in total. While the person types (`prompt.edit` seen within the last 2 s) and while `$.ui.panes()` reports the pane with `isPlaced` false, the timer rests on the static frame; the band never animates, and off the terminal nothing animates.
animation.staticFrame: The pane meter as mocked on line 3: 26 `█` in a dim cyan gradient from #0e7f91 at the left to #15a9c0, the two road cells just behind the lamp at full #22e3ff, every other cell 8% darker as a faint scanline, one `▐` tail-light in #ff3fd6 on the bg2 lane colour, and 43 `·` studs in dim on the bg2 lane. On a finished run the whole track is the dim gradient with no lamp and no #22e3ff cells; at done = 0 it is the plain `·` lane with no lamp. This is also what the pane shows the moment it opens, on a light theme (with the light pair: #006983 for the bright cells, #b0169a lamp, #e3eaf7 lane), and whenever the breath is paused.

feasibility: Everything mocked is drawable: Box/Text/Button only, no borders; glyphs are box drawing, block elements (`█ ▐ ▁▂▃▄▅`), geometric shapes and the middot `·`, all width-1 BMP, and no shade block (U+2591–2593) is used. The 70×1 Raster packs 70 u32 triplets (well under the 1024-pair palette) and `$.ui.blit` repaints it under the pane's requestId; the tail-light is glyph `▐` with fg accent2 and bg the bg2 lane colour, so its left half shows lane surface and its right half the lamp, and the lane cells are glyph `·` with fg dim on the same bg2. The Raster is terminal-only, so desktop and mobile get the Svg and Text fallbacks above, and the meter's gradient, scanline and lane background cannot be expressed in the {tone} mock markup, hence line 3 shows a flat accent run, the sliver and dim studs on the page background. In two-column mode (100 columns inline) the Raster is mounted at the left column's width and the glow row spans that column. The band's meter needs `bar.filled` split into two Segs (`bar`, the `█` run, and `bar-edge`, the one `▐`) at the same drop level, with `bar.empty` becoming the `·` lane (`█` dim when not mono); in the Text band `▐` has no background, so its dark half is the terminal's own and the sliver reads as a lamp just ahead of the road; the step title is the plain Button's string label in `text` bold as today. The bg2 glow row needs `Box backgroundColor` across the whole row; the Button label inside it keeps its own background unset, so the band is drawn by the row Box, not by the label. Theme detection reads the `theme` row of `$.config.list()` (async, so once at session start in register.tsx, cached in state and refreshed by an `on('config.set', { key: 'theme' })` hook; ConfigRow has `key` and `value`); if the row is hidden or unknown the Text surfaces fall back to theme keys and the Raster is replaced by the Text meter, as the tokenMap says. The sparkline needs commit timestamps bucketed per hour, which `facts.commits[].at` already provides. Typing awareness uses the `prompt.edit` hook (fires per edit by the person) and visibility uses `isPlaced` from `$.ui.panes()`; without either the breath simply keeps its 1 fps cadence.
implementationNotes:
- `view.tsx`: add a `theme.ts` module exporting `GLYPH`, `TONE` and a pure `accentOf(themeName)` → `{accent, accent2, bg2, success}` hex pair; `register.tsx` reads the `theme` config row once at session start, stores the pair in state, refreshes it on `config.set` for `theme`, and passes it in `ViewData`; `TONE.doing` becomes `accent2`, the health/phase `▶` and the active footer chip take `accent`, section labels stay `text` bold, NEEDS YOU takes `warning` (error when a blocker exists).
- `meter()`: returns `{ road, lamp, lane }` instead of `{ filled, empty }`: `road` is `█`.repeat(n − 1), `lamp` is `▐` (empty when n is 0 or equals `cells`, in which case `road` takes all n), `lane` is `·`.repeat(cells − n) when mono and `█`.repeat(cells − n) otherwise (drawn dim either way), so no shade block is ever emitted.
- `rule()`: `┄` instead of `─`, label bold in `text` (warning/error for NEEDS YOU), tail right-justified; `needsBlock` gets no tail (`+n more` only when `max` truncates) and a 5-cell meta column (`id` or age, padEnd(5)) plus a 2-cell gap; `signalsBlock` uses the same 5-cell label column (`gate `, `git  `, `ctx  `) so values start at col 10; `stepRow` indents four cells, shows the running agent on a todo row too, shows `? D1` on the step a decision blocks, and wraps the doing row in `<Box backgroundColor={bg2}>`.
- Header: a third row that mounts `<Raster key="meter" columns={width} rows={1} cells={meterCells(done,total,width,pair)}>` on the terminal (width = the left column's width in two-column mode; the Text meter when the pair is unknown) and `<Svg>`/Text elsewhere; `meterCells` emits the `█` gradient cells, one `▐` cell (fg accent2, bg bg2) and the `·` lane cells (fg dim, bg bg2), with no `▐` when done is 0 or total; `bandSegments` keeps the Text meter and splits it into `bar` (`█` run, accent), `bar-edge` (`▐`, accent2, absent when done is 0 or total) and `bar-lane` (`·`, dim) at drop 6, emits each ` ┆ ` separator as its own dim Seg at its segment's drop level (`sep-gate` at 3, `sep-git` at 5, `sep-agents` at 4, `sep-elapsed` at 7) so toned segments never color it; widths and drop levels are unchanged.
- `signalsBlock`: three rows with the 5-cell label column and right-justified `52s` / sparkline `6 today` / `$4.10`; `sparkline(commits, now, 8)` buckets `facts.commits[].at` per hour into ` ▁▂▃▄▅` (space for 0), drawn dim.
- `register.tsx`: a `$.clock.every(1000, …)` that blits the tail-light cell through the three breath stops while the pane is mounted, `isPlaced` is true and `lastEdit` (stamped by a `prompt.edit` hook) is older than 2 s; on a `counts` increase it schedules the 4-frame sweep (the `▐` advances one cell per blit, the cell behind it repainted as a gradient `█`); a gate pass sets a 3 s `edgeTone` state tick that paints the tail-light with the pair's success hex.
- Footer: tab Buttons hold Text chips (`<Text color={accent} backgroundColor={bg2}> 1 Overview </Text>` for the active one, dim hotkey plus plain label for the rest); tests cover `bandSegments` widths at 100 and 60 (with the separator Segs, the `bar-edge` and the `bar-lane`), `meter()` output (`███▐······` for 7 of 18 at 10 cells, `··········` at 0, `██████████` at total, the `█` lane when not mono), `meterCells` lit counts (4 of 10, 27 of 70) and the no-lamp cases, the absence of shade blocks (U+2591–2593) in every meter output, the sparkline bucketing, and the light/dark pair choice including the unknown-theme fallback.
